newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Bourse's money market starts operation.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Bourse's money market starts operation.

text.p: Istanbul Stock Exchange Settlement and Custody Bank Takasbank A.S. on Tuesday launched its separate money market for members.
Takasbank has said that the Stock Exchange Money Market will enable the Istanbul bourse members to utilise their surplus funds and meet their cash.
The bourse members will be able to borrow and lend money through the market and their minimum transaction limits were set as 500 million lira.
They will be alloted certain cash and non-cash limits.
The bank sets three different limits to members, for its three instruments introduced as lending cash, lending share and stock exchange money market.
Takasbank intervenes the operations only when a member exceeds its limits.

The contracts made on the new money market will be under the guarantee of Takasbank. The bank does not run the operations but provides the framework for all bourse members to make deals directly with each other.
The market will operate between 0700-1130 GMT and transactions will be made as today's value and overnight.
